title: UFC 334 Start Time at MSG: Full Card and How to Watch Gane vs. Hokit
yt_title: UFC 334 Start Time Tonight at MSG: Gane vs. Hokit, Harrison vs. Nunes and How to Watch

slides.label: Start times
slides.text: Early prelims *5 PM ET*. Prelims *7 PM*. Main card *9 PM*. Doors open at 4.

slides.label: How to watch
slides.text: Every fight streams on *Paramount+ only*. No pay-per-view, no CBS. There is a *Spanish-language* stream too.

slides.label: Main event
slides.text: *Ciryl Gane* puts the heavyweight title on the line against unbeaten *Josh Hokit (10-0)*.

slides.label: Co-main
slides.text: *Kayla Harrison* defends her bantamweight title against *Amanda Nunes*, finally on after a January postponement.

slides.label: Late changes
slides.text: *Alatengheili* replaces Adrian Yanez against Juan Diaz. Sadykhov vs. Nascimento is *off*.

slides.label: Getting there
slides.text: *1, 2, 3, A, C, E* to Penn Station. LIRR, NJ Transit and PATH all drop you at the Garden.

caption_linkedin:
UFC 334: Two Title Fights Tonight at Madison Square Garden

UFC returns to MSG tonight, almost exactly ten years after UFC 205 made the Garden debut once New York lifted its ban on professional MMA. Since then UFC has come back to the Garden every November except 2020.

The night also shows where sports rights are heading: every fight streams on Paramount+ only, with no pay-per-view and no broadcast simulcast, in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

On the card: Ciryl Gane vs. Josh Hokit for the heavyweight title, and Kayla Harrison vs. Amanda Nunes for the bantamweight title.

Streaming-only for a marquee event: smart access or lost reach?

By The Innovators Den. Sources: UFC.com, Paramount+, MMA Junkie.
